entries.source_path_or_artifact: canonical registry, ScopeGraph, ResearchClaim, RepresentationRequirement, ResearchBundle identity/promotion mechanisms
entries.behavior_or_invariant: Learner-independent subject semantics are versioned, provenance-bound and deterministically packaged.
semantic_differences: Learner state may influence study scope but cannot mutate canonical truth.

entries.source_path_or_artifact: SourceLedger, rights/use state, ExamDemandProfile and question content/occurrence/evidence ledgers
entries.behavior_or_invariant: Subject truth is separated from source/exam/question evidence and evidence carries provenance and use state.
semantic_differences: V2 evidence participates in dependency-closed canonical adjudication but remains distinct from canonical truth.

entries.source_path_or_artifact: PublicationStructure, PhysicalPageMap, placement evidence, PDF hash binding, PublicationAudit/Manifest and independent validators
entries.behavior_or_invariant: Material semantic content is traceable through structure and physical placement to an exact hash-bound artifact.
semantic_differences: V2 publication consumes already-owned StudyModel and LearningDesign outputs; realization cannot decide study content.

entries.behavior_or_invariant: The old Core2 path proved executable learning-design binding but combined responsibilities that V2 separates.
semantic_differences: Study selection moves to V2 Core2-A Study Synthesis.
LearningDesign is narrowed to teaching choreography and may not rewrite StudyModel obligations.
old_validation: LearningDesign contract executable on exercised paths

entries.behavior_or_invariant: Learner evidence is append-only/descriptive and remains distinct from observation, diagnosis, state and teaching decisions.
semantic_differences: V2 binds evidence to deterministic as-of/temporal policy and separates research/publication projections.

entries.source_path_or_artifact: ReasoningObservation, DiagnosticCase, LearnerStateSnapshot and scoped LearnerStateView contracts
entries.behavior_or_invariant: Learner state is derived from evidence under explicit policy and is not canonical subject truth or a teaching decision.
semantic_differences: V2 snapshot identity must bind evidence digest, registry version, diagnostic policy and explicit temporal input.

entries.source_path_or_artifact: CapabilityDefinition, ErrorSignature, DiagnosticProbe and Math/Physics/Chemistry reasoning contracts
entries.behavior_or_invariant: A shared evidence engine can reference discipline-specific reasoning semantics and shared dependencies without collapsing subjects into one diagnostic model.
semantic_differences: Canonical capability/reasoning meaning is owned by Core1; learner-specific observations and states remain in Learner Intelligence.
Cross-subject recurrence remains a hypothesis/evidence pattern rather than a durable learner trait unless separately established.

entries.behavior_or_invariant: Wrong answers preserve successful checkpoints, localize failure, retain competing hypotheses and produce probes when evidence is ambiguous.
semantic_differences: V2 inference is integrated with deterministic temporal semantics and clean V2 capability identities.

entries.source_path_or_artifact: anonymized synthetic Math/Physics/Chemistry answer-sheet acceptance fixtures
entries.behavior_or_invariant: Synthetic fixtures test inference behavior but are not evidence about a real learner.
semantic_differences: Fixtures may be normalized to V2 IDs but must retain synthetic/test provenance.
old_validation: cross-subject acceptance fixture exercised against Phase 3 policy

entries.source_path_or_artifact: general evidence-dimension/support/route-change invariants from Primary architecture
entries.behavior_or_invariant: Independent use, delayed retention and transfer are distinguishable evidence dimensions; repeated same-route failure may justify a meaningful route change.
semantic_differences: No Primary ontology, grade-specific runtime contract or mastery enum is imported into Grade 9–11 V2.
old_validation: Primary canonical semantics implemented in PR #163/#164
new_validation_required: independent Grade 9–11 justification before any later adoption

entries.source_path_or_artifact: benchmark gap hypotheses, teaching-primitive candidates and human review dimensions
entries.behavior_or_invariant: Technically correct custody does not prove instructional sufficiency; benchmark-derived RCA can expose validation gaps.
semantic_differences: No PR #156/#157-derived page grammar or teaching primitive becomes producer truth in V2-00A.
new_validation_required: independent pedagogical justification before any producer-side adoption
